items.headline: CoreWeave beats Q3 and raises FY26 guidance, but total debt nears $47B on $37-39B capex plan
items.note: Revenue and backlog are strong, but the heavy debt load and capex keep funding risk at the center of the neocloud credit thesis.

items.headline: CoreWeave 2032 notes yield above 16% and CDS hits record ahead of Q3 earnings
items.note: Bonds yielding nearly double their 9.625% coupon and record CDS levels show the market pricing CoreWeave debt as distressed. Figures vary by source.
